_why: Ties the Android adaptive layers to the brand mark they are cut from. #50 replaced assets/icon.png and left these behind, and no gate noticed. src/icon-assets.test.ts re-runs the generator recorded here and compares pixels, so a brand change that skips regeneration fails at commit time instead of shipping.
background_color_rule: per-channel median of source pixels with mark-mask < plateMaskCeiling and alpha >= plateAlphaFloor
